summary: Daemon and CLI identity contracts accept FRACTAL aliases while launches retain matching ST names

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Daemon launch assignments and identity removals cover matching FRACTAL and ST names. CLI defaults, daemon peer attribution, native driver paths and Codex app-server configuration use the shared preferred-FRACTAL resolver. Conflicting or masked identities cannot fall back to person authority or an ancestor identity. Existing flags and ST consumers remain supported; shell and TypeScript hook migration is separate.

downtime.detail: No service replacement or seat restart required.

manual.detail: No action required for existing ST-only consumers. Resolve conflicting manually authored identity aliases before launching a seat or CLI command.

recovery.detail: No durable state changes. Existing ST names remain exported and readable.
